Name: Speeder Bike Horse Replacer
Author: FoolishGent
Description:
This mod uses the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] to replace your horse with a speeder bike.

Your speeder can be to one of three different styles: Jakku, Endor, and Tatooine. Designs are swappable in the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] or by manully entering the name of the design you want in the "config.json" file.

I highly recommend VoidWitchCult's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17084](CP) No reins for me[/url] mod to remove the orange reins that pop up when the Farmer is riding. 


[b][u]Installation:
[/u][/b]1. Download and install the required mods. 
2. Download this mod's .zip file.
3. Unpack the zip into the "Stardew Valley/Mods" folder created by SMAPI
4. Run the game with SMAPI
5. Hover on down the road.

[b][u]Compatibility:
[/u][/b]This mod will not work with other mods that replace your horse.
